name: Alba de Cerrato (Spain)
description: Square white flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alba de Cerrato (a castle on red and fleurs-de-lis on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Alba de Cerrato; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alba de Cerrato arms — castle on red and fleurs-de-lis on blue
